SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS 销售总额
FROM dim_region t1
INNER JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.region_id = t2.region_id
WHERE t1.region_name = '华北'

SELECT SUM(t1.order_amount) AS GMV
FROM fact_order t1
JOIN dim_date t2 ON t1.date_id = t2.date_id
WHERE t2.quarter = 'Q1' AND t2.date_id >= 20250101 AND t2.date_id <= 20250331

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数量
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.province = '广东省' AND dp.category = '手机数码';

SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS 订单总金额
FROM dim_customer t1
INNER JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id
WHERE t1.member_level = '黄金'

SELECT SUM(t3.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order t3
JOIN dim_region t1 ON t3.region_id = t1.region_id
JOIN dim_product t2 ON t3.product_id = t2.product_id
WHERE t1.region_name = '华北' AND t2.brand = '华为'

SELECT SUM(t1.order_quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_order t1
JOIN dim_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id
WHERE t2.product_name = 'iPhone 15 Pro';

SELECT dp.product_name AS 商品名称
FROM dim_product dp
JOIN fact_order fo ON dp.product_id = fo.product_id
GROUP BY dp.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(fo.order_quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.day AS 日, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.date_id >= 20250301 AND d.date_id <= 20250331
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day;

SELECT SUM(t2.order_quantity) AS 销量
FROM dim_product t1
JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id
JOIN dim_date t3 ON t2.date_id = t3.date_id
WHERE t1.category = '宇宙飞船' AND t3.year = 2026

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.order_amount), 0) AS 销售额
FROM dim_region t1
JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.region_id = t2.region_id
WHERE t1.region_name = '南极'
